arguments.body:
Packing Checklist:
- [ ] Clothing (weather-appropriate)
- [ ] Toiletries & personal care
- [ ] Electronics (phone, charger, etc.)
- [ ] Medications & first aid
- [ ] Travel documents (passport, ID, tickets)
- [ ] Snacks & water bottle
- [ ] Books or entertainment
- [ ] Umbrella or rain gear
- [ ] Comfortable shoes
- [ ] Any other items needed
